description: Intercom API actions for AI agents.

commands.name: list_contacts
commands.description: You can fetch a list of all contacts (ie. users or leads) in your workspace.

per_page.description: The number of items returned in a single response. Default is 20.

starting_after.description: The cursor used for pagination in order to fetch the next page of results.

commands.name: create_contact
commands.description: You can create a new contact (ie. user or lead), Provide at least one of: email, external_id, or role.

external_id.description: A unique identifier for the contact which is given to Intercom

email_verified.description: Whether the contact's email address has been verified. Set to true to indicate you have verified the contact owns this email address, or false to mark it as unverified. Must be supplied together with an email in the same request; sending it without an email returns a 400.

avatar.description: An image URL containing the avatar of a contact

signed_up_at.description: (Unix timestamp in seconds) The time specified for when a contact signed up.

last_seen_at.description: (Unix timestamp in seconds) The time when the contact was last seen (either where the Intercom Messenger was installed or when specified manually).

owner_id.description: The id of an admin that has been assigned account ownership of the contact

unsubscribed_from_emails.description: Whether the contact is unsubscribed from emails

custom_attributes.description: Custom attributes for the contact. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, or nested objects.
